newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 21.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for April 21.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open on Monday, the Communications and Transport Ministry (SCT) said in its 1000 local/1500 GMT daily meteorological report.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Pacific Coast, Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean.
Clear skies and maximum winds from 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour), with waves three to seven feet high.

Light rains along coasts of Tamaulipas and Veracruz states, and strong gusts along coasts of Tabasco and Yucatan peninsula. Winds between 10 and 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 16 miles per hour) with waves three to six feet high. -- Caribbean:
Hot and partly cloudy with some rains and wind gusts. Winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
